title: PlanReading
description: What the AI sends after reading an operating plan document. Railway terms only, no coordinates. Code turns this into the canvas plan. Version 0.2.

arrival.description: One plan covers one arrival direction. A different direction is a different plan.

on.description: The main track the train arrives on.

locos.description: Where the power is in the arriving train, relative to its direction of travel.

carLength.description: Default car length. The allowance is added on top and always shown, so 60 ft at 10% plans as 66 ft per car.

lengthFt.description: Usable length. Leave out if the document doesn't say; the editor will ask.

end.description: What is at the far end of the track, away from the switch it leaves from. Main tracks continue.

on.description: The track the switch sits on.

to.description: The track the diverging route leads to.

side.description: Which side the diverging route leaves on, as seen by the arriving train.

approach.description: Facing or trailing point for the arriving train.

order.description: 1 for the first switch the arriving train reaches on this track, 2 for the next, and so on.

distanceFt.description: Distance from the previous switch on the same track, or from where the drawing starts for the first one.

lengthFt.description: Length of track alongside the facility.

startFt.description: Where the facility starts, measured from the switch end of its track. Leave out to place it at the far end.

spots.description: Number of car spots, if the document shows them.

cuts.description: Groups of cars in the arriving train, listed from the head end back.

carLengthFt.description: Overrides the default car length for this cut.

for.description: Facility these cars are going to, if any.

onSite.description: Cars already sitting on customer or other tracks before the train arrives, such as empties waiting to be pulled.

work.description: Spotting and yard work, in order. Customer steps can appear anywhere.

cars.description: Cuts that leave with the train.

unsure.description: Fields the AI is not confident about, as dotted paths (e.g. tracks.SPUR1.lengthFt). The editor highlights them.

notes.description: Anything in the document that didn't fit the fields above.

do.description: shove: push cars ahead of the power. pull: draw cars behind the power. cut_off: uncouple the power and leave cars. couple: couple to cars. run_light: move the power alone. runaround: get the power to the other end of its cars. set_out: leave cars on a track. pick_up: collect cars from a track.

to.description: Facility or track id the move ends at.

via.description: Switches passed through, in order, if the document says.

to.description: For move_cars: the facility or track the customer moves cars to.
